$description: Position and translation tokens for movement animations. Defines offset distances, path types, and motion trajectories.

micro.$description: Subtle shifts, micro-feedback. Use for hover states, icon nudges.

small.$description: Small movements. Use for button press feedback, list item shifts.

medium.$description: Standard movement distance. Use for card entrances, modal slides.

large.$description: Pronounced movement. Use for drawer slides, panel transitions.

xlarge.$description: Dramatic movement. Use for hero entrances, page transitions.

xxlarge.$description: Extreme movement. Use for off-screen origins, dramatic reveals.

viewport-quarter.$description: Quarter viewport width. Use for slide-in panels.

viewport-half.$description: Half viewport width. Use for split-screen transitions.

viewport-full.$description: Full viewport width. Use for page swipes, carousel slides.

viewport-height-quarter.$description: Quarter viewport height. Use for bottom sheet peek.

viewport-height-half.$description: Half viewport height. Use for modal slides.

viewport-height-full.$description: Full viewport height. Use for vertical page transitions.

up.$description: Upward movement vector. Common for entrance animations (slide up).

down.$description: Downward movement vector. Common for dropdown, gravity effects.

left.$description: Leftward movement vector. Use for forward navigation (LTR).

right.$description: Rightward movement vector. Use for back navigation (LTR).

linear.$description: Straight-line motion. Use for mechanical, precise movements.

arc-subtle.$description: Gentle arc for small aspect ratio changes. Natural feel.

arc-standard.$description: Standard arc for medium morphs. Google M3 default.

arc-dramatic.$description: Pronounced arc for large transformations. Theatrical motion.

arc-threshold.$description: Use arc motion when aspect ratio changes by more than 10%. Google M3 container transform rule.

radius-small.$description: Small orbit radius. Use for loading spinners, icon orbits.

radius-medium.$description: Medium orbit radius. Use for decorative orbits.

radius-large.$description: Large orbit radius. Use for satellite elements, hero decorations.

speed-slow.$description: Slow orbit cycle. Ambient, background motion.

speed-medium.$description: Medium orbit cycle. Noticeable but not distracting.

speed-fast.$description: Fast orbit cycle. Active, energetic motion.

amplitude-subtle.$description: Subtle drift range. Barely perceptible float.

amplitude-gentle.$description: Gentle drift range. Calm floating effect.

amplitude-noticeable.$description: Noticeable drift range. Visible ambient motion.
